phases_and_microstructures.name: ultrafine nm-sized gamma''
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: aged with 40 Hz EPT, 5% tensile strain at 800 C

attributes.composition: Ni3Nb; ordered D022 structure; coherent with gamma matrix, misfit about 2.03 %

evidence.quote: The fast Fourier transform pattern of the images taken from the <110> and <112> zone axis show that the matrix is FCC structure and precipitate is ordered D022 structure. The ultrafine nm-sized γ″ phase is coherent with γ matrix, and the misfit is about 2.03 %.
The average size of ultrafine nm-sized γ′′ phase increases with the increasing EPT frequency (in the alloy with 10 Hz-EPT is about 5 nm and 40 Hz-EPT is about 21 nm).

evidence.quote: in the alloy aged with 10 Hz-EPT, large amount of ultrafine nm-sized γ′′ phases precipitate with strain near fracture surface as shown in the circle in Fig. 4(b).
The average size of ultrafine nm-sized γ′′ phase increases with the increasing EPT frequency (in the alloy with 10 Hz-EPT is about 5 nm and 40 Hz-EPT is about 21 nm).

phases_and_microstructures.name: dislocation
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: aged with 10 Hz electric-pulse treatment, 5% strain

evidence.quote: The γ′′ phases around dislocation forming chain morphology impedes dislocation motion and dislocation tangle is serious around them as shown in Fig. 2(b), leading to increasing of strength.

It concludes that vacancy concentration is large increase and dislocation concentration is slight increase in the alloy aged with EPT comparing to those of normal aged alloy. In another word, EPT induces to form more vacancies.

mechanisms.name: dislocation pile-up and tangle at gamma'' chains

evidence.quote: The γ′′ phases around dislocation forming chain morphology impedes dislocation motion and dislocation tangle is serious around them as shown in Fig. 2(b), leading to increasing of strength.

mechanisms.name: grain boundary pinning by delta phase

evidence.quote: The granular δ phase precipitates at grain boundary, which pins and restrains grain boundary slip at high temperature. The grain boundary strength improves.

The size of ultrafine nm-sized γ′′ phase is very small and lattice parameter is almost the same with γ matrix, leading to dislocation shear ultrafine nm-sized γ′′ phase. The elastic interaction is between precipitate and dislocation, thereby crack hardly initiates at phase-matrix interface owing to negligible strain accumulation.

mechanisms.name: crack deflection along granular delta phase

evidence.quote: Cracks have to propagate along granular δ phases so that both the propagation pathway and the energy consume increase, which leads to the elongation increase.

The electrical resistivity is sensitive to defect such as grain boundary, dislocation [31]. The resistivity in the area with defects is higher than that without defect. Joule heat effect enhances and the temperature rise is more rapidly around dislocation. Moreover, γ′′ phases prefer to nucleate around dislocation.
The vacancy is the nucleation location for ultrafine nm-sized γ′′ phase precipitating.

Vacancy strengthening mechanism leads to increasing of yield stress during the initial stage of tensile deformation.
The γ′′ phases around dislocation forming chain morphology impedes dislocation motion and dislocation tangle is serious around them as shown in Fig. 2(b), leading to increasing of strength.
The granular δ phase precipitates at grain boundary, which pins and restrains grain boundary slip at high temperature. The grain boundary strength improves.
The size of ultrafine nm-sized γ′′ phase is very small and lattice parameter is almost the same with γ matrix, leading to dislocation shear ultrafine nm-sized γ′′ phase.
Cracks have to propagate along granular δ phases so that both the propagation pathway and the energy consume increase, which leads to the elongation increase.
